purpose: Fix the dated vascular-plant phylogeny source and crosswalk rules before learning which BIEN family x trait systems qualify structurally.

phylogeny_source.reason: This is the package default dated vascular-plant megatree and was named in the original programme source matrix before BIEN outcomes.

construction.species_input: BIEN scrubbed_species_binomial with BIEN scrubbed genus and family
construction.rule: No outcome-informed switching among S1/S2/S3 or TPL/LCVP/WP backbones.

temporal_primary.tree: S3 tree for the eligible BIEN species list
temporal_primary.separation: patristic distance normalized within family x trait as frozen in the core programme

mandatory_backbone_native_sensitivity.admission_rule: A family x trait system cannot enter the primary cross-axis H1/H2 synthesis unless the prune-only backbone-native subset independently retains at least the original temporal minimum of 20 species.
mandatory_backbone_native_sensitivity.reason: The mandatory sensitivity must itself be estimable rather than becoming a token analysis based on a handful of directly represented tips.

reporting: number and fraction of prune/bind/fail-to-bind species per family x trait
forbidden: fuzzy taxonomic matching chosen after turnover results
dropping bound tips only when they weaken an effect
using Open Tree synthetic branch lengths as calibrated time
crosswalk_gate_after_structural_support: Run only on structurally qualifying family x trait systems; this reduces computation but does not alter the pre-frozen crosswalk/admission rules.
